premise: An 80-year-old sword saint who retired to a quiet mountain village decades ago. He was once the best swordsman in the kingdom.

draft.premise: An 80-year-old sword saint who retired to a quiet mountain village decades ago. He was once the best swordsman in the kingdom.

world.title: The Sword Saint's Autumn
world.era: Medieval kingdom: steel blades, horse carriages, and parchment letters

extraordinary.reach: Enhancing physical strikes, cutting through solid stone with wind pressure, and sensing incoming attacks.

rules.text: Refining one's sword aura preserves the spirit and extends natural lifespan, but cannot heal structural physical decay.
Only a true martial master can project their sword aura outwardly to strike targets from a distance.

peoples.name: Human
peoples.description: The dominant people of the kingdom.

rungs.name: Novice
rungs.description: One who has just begun to hold a blade and feel their inner energy.

rungs.name: Swordsman
rungs.description: A seasoned fighter capable of reinforcing their weapon with basic aura.

rungs.name: Sword Master
rungs.description: A martial expert who can project aura outwardly, slicing iron like paper.

rungs.name: Sword Saint
rungs.description: A living legend whose blade is an extension of their soul. A rare peak of mortal cultivation.

travel.description: Travel is slow, done on foot or by horse carriage. News travels via royal couriers.

laws.text: All sworn martial artists of the kingdom must answer the royal crown's call in times of war.

places.name: Misty Vales
places.description: A secluded, fog-shrouded mountain range far from the capital.

places.name: Yamasuki Village
places.description: A quiet, peaceful mountain settlement of farmers and woodcutters.

places.name: The Mountain Cabin
places.description: A simple, rustic wooden cabin nestled among bamboo and pines.

places.name: The High Pass
places.description: The narrow, rocky gateway connecting the Misty Vales to the lowlands.

places.name: The Royal Capital
places.description: The bustling, stone-walled heart of the kingdom, currently tense with talk of impending war.

factions.name: The Royal Court
factions.description: The rulers of the realm, desperate for martial power to defend their borders.
factions.goal: Locate and draft the legendary retired Sword Saint back into military service.
factions.methods: Deploying royal investigators and envoys to track down rumors.
factions.strength: Thousands of soldiers and the authority of the crown.

factions.name: The Flying Swords Sect
factions.description: An ambitious martial arts sect looking to prove their dominance in the kingdom.
factions.goal: Defeat the legendary Sword Saint to claim his ultimate techniques and renown.
factions.methods: Sending young, elite disciples to locate and challenge him.
factions.strength: Highly skilled aura-users and influential martial masters.

npcs.name: Mei
npcs.description: A diligent and quiet local orphan girl who cooks, cleans, and secretly practices the wooden sword.
npcs.appearance: A young girl of eighteen with dark hair tied back in a practical bun, wearing patched homespun cotton robes.

loves: the sound of the sword sweeping the air
fears: old age taking her master away
wants: to master the basic sword stances

traits.name: Unwavering Loyalty
traits.description: She would stand before a charging horse to protect her master.

npcs.name: Commander Reynold
npcs.description: A grim and battle-worn imperial envoy tasked with bringing the Sword Saint back.
npcs.appearance: A tall, broad-shouldered man in his early forties, wearing dented silver plate armor and a dark grey cloak.

wants: to find the Sword Saint and draft him

agenda.goal: Bring the Sword Saint to the capital to lead the vanguard.
agenda.method: Appealing to his old oath to the crown, or threatening to draft the villagers if he refuses.
agenda.secret: He has been ordered to take the Saint by force if necessary, though he doubts he has the power to do so.

clocks.name: The Royal Envoy's Search
steps: Rumors of royal scouts reaching the base of the mountain.
Commander Reynold questions travellers at the High Pass.
The royal detachment begins ascending to Yamasuki Village.
Commander Reynold arrives at your cabin door.

threads.title: The Ghost of the Kingdom
threads.stakes: Your peaceful retirement is threatened by a desperate kingdom's draft.

mysteries.question: Why did the kingdom's greatest sword saint suddenly vanish thirty years ago?
mysteries.answer: He discovered that his final, legendary duel was orchestrated by the late King to assassinate a righteous rebel lord who wanted reform.
clues: A faded, wax-sealed royal decree hidden in a false bottom of your old sword chest.
The chipped, broken hilt of his rival's sword buried beneath the pine tree behind the cabin.

known_facts: You were once the celebrated Sword Saint of the kingdom.
Thirty years ago, you walked away from fame, glory, and blood to live in obscurity.
Your old bones ache in the mountain dampness, reminding you that even saints cannot escape time.

opening.situation: You sit by the crackling hearth sipping hot bamboo tea, resting your aching, eighty-year-old knees while young Mei sweeps the wooden floor with rhythmic, disciplined strokes of her broom.

world.summary: An eighty-year-old retired Sword Saint lives a peaceful, hidden life in a remote mountain cabin, teaching a young orphan girl. However, a looming war prompts the Royal Court to hunt down the living legend, threatening his quiet retirement.

character.name: Shin
character.description: An old, unassuming mountain dweller with a sharp, piercing gaze that occasionally betrays his legendary past.
character.appearance: A thin, elderly man with long white hair tied loosely, a weathered face marked by deep lines of wisdom, wearing simple, patched grey cotton robes.

skills.name: Swordplay
skills.notes: Even in old age, your form is flawless and your movements are effortless.

skills.name: Meditation
skills.notes: Used to refine aura and calm the mind.

skills.name: Survival
skills.notes: Gathering herbs, woodcutting, and living off the mountain.

traits.name: Aching Joints
traits.description: Old age and past battle wounds make your body stiff and painful in damp or cold weather.

traits.name: Unreadable Presence
traits.description: You can completely mask your martial strength, appearing as nothing more than a fragile old farmer.

powers.name: Cloud-Cutting Aura
limits: Your physical body can only sustain intense aura projection for short bursts before your old muscles fail.

costs.text: Using your full aura forces you to rest for several hours to recover from deep physical exhaustion.

techniques.name: First Form: Flowing Water
techniques.effect: Deflects incoming attacks using minimal physical effort.

techniques.name: Final Form: Heaven's Sever
techniques.effect: A single, blindingly fast slash reinforced with projected aura that can slice steel.
techniques.requirements: A steel blade and focused aura

fears: bringing blood and war to this peaceful village

items.name: Old Wooden Training Sword
items.description: An old practice sword made of heavy oak, smooth from years of use.

items.name: Cloud-Cutter Katana
items.description: Your legendary steel sword, now wrapped in dusty cloth and hidden beneath your bed.

character.title: Sword Saint
backstory: You fought in the Great Unification wars decades ago, earning the title of the kingdom's greatest swordsman.
Disillusioned by the cruelty of the court, you fled into retirement, letting the world believe you had died of your wounds.
